description: "Sans-Cravate; or, The Messengers; Little Streams" by Paul de Kock is a novel written in the early 19th century. The narrative focuses on a group of young men frequenting the fashionable Boulevard des Italiens in Paris, exploring their interactions with women and the social nuances of Parisian life.
